skills.description: This skill should be used when the user (a publisher editor or content director) needs to optimize a basic book topic proposal / topic report into a professional, market-driven, high-value topic plan. Triggers include: 编辑提供的基础版选题策划方案、选题报告、新书策划案、选题方向、立项报告需要深度优化. The skill performs multi-dimensional analysis (4P/4C/STP/SWOT/3C/PEST/波特五力) covering product positioning, content value, author background, competitor benchmarking (开卷数据/同类对标书), reader profiling, marketing strategy, book format suggestions (开本/页数/定价), and sales forecasting.
